# Calculate Initial Constants 
mu_lam1 <- mean(data$count, na.rm = TRUE)  
nyear <- length(unique(data$year))  
ndelta <- length(unique(data$Variable)) 
nscale <- length(unique(data$Scale))  
nsite <- length(unique(data$site)) 
nvisit <- max(data$visit)  

# Initialize count array
count_array <- array(NA, dim = c(nvisit, nyear, ndelta, nscale, nsite))

# Populate count_array with counts
for (i in 1:nvisit) {
  for (j in 1:nyear) {
    for (k in 1:ndelta) {
      for (s in 1:nscale) {
        for (v in 1:nsite) {
          subset_data <- data %>%
            filter(visit == unique(data$visit)[i],
                   year == unique(data$year)[j],
                   Variable == unique(data$Variable)[k],
                   Scale == unique(data$Scale)[s],
                   site == unique(data$site)[v])
         
          count_array[i, j, k, s, v] <- if (nrow(subset_data) > 0) {
            mean(subset_data$count, na.rm = TRUE)
          } else {
            NA
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

# Initialize detection covariates Array
X_det <- array(NA, dim = c(nvisit, nyear, ndelta, nscale, nsite))

for (v in 1:nvisit) {
  for (t in 1:nyear) {
    for (d in 1:ndelta) {
      for (s in 1:nscale) {
        for (i in 1:nsite) {
          subset_values <- data %>%
            filter(year == unique(data$year)[t],
                   Variable == unique(data$Variable)[d],
                   Scale == unique(data$Scale)[s],
                   visit == unique(data$visit)[v],
                   site == unique(data$site)[i]) %>%
            pull(Value)
         
          X_det[v, t, d, s, i] <- if (length(subset_values) > 0) {
            mean(subset_values, na.rm = TRUE)
          } else {
            NA
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
# Display results

# Define the NIMBLE Model
nimblemodel <- nimbleCode({
  ### Priors
  off <- 0.00001  
  ss ~ dunif(1, (nscale - off))  
  ss_trunc <- trunc(ss)
  prop_scales <- ss - ss_trunc
 
  for (i in 1:nsite) {
    for (t in 1:nyear) {
      # Linear interpolation for cover variables
      w_tree_height[i, t] <- tree_height[i, t, ss_trunc] * (1 - prop_scales) +
        tree_height[i, t, ss_trunc + 1] * prop_scales
      w_canopy_cover[i, t] <- canopy_cover[i, t, ss_trunc] * (1 - prop_scales) +
        canopy_cover[i, t, ss_trunc + 1] * prop_scales
      w_grassland[i, t] <- grassland[i, t, ss_trunc] * (1 - prop_scales) +
        grassland[i, t, ss_trunc + 1] * prop_scales
      w_forest[i, t] <- forest[i, t, ss_trunc] * (1 - prop_scales) +
        forest[i, t, ss_trunc + 1] * prop_scales
    }
  }
 
  # Initial year
  alpha0 ~ dnorm(mu_lam1, sd = 2)  
  sd_alpha ~ dunif(0, 5)  
 
  # Fixed effects
  beta0 ~ dnorm(0, sd = 1)  
  beta_tree_height ~ dnorm(0, sd = 3)  
  beta_canopy_cover ~ dnorm(0, sd = 3) 
  beta_grassland ~ dnorm(0, sd = 3) 
  beta_forest ~ dnorm(0, sd = 3)  
 
  # Detection
  delta[1] ~ dnorm(0, sd = 2)  
  delta[2] ~ dnorm(0, sd = 2)  
  for (j in 3:ndelta) {  
    delta[j] ~ dnorm(0, sd = 3)
  }
  sd_p ~ dunif(0, 5)  
 
  ### Likelihood
  # Latent process
  for (i in 1:nsite) {
    llam[i] ~ dnorm(alpha0, sd = sd_alpha)
    log(lam[i, 1]) <- llam[i]
    N[i, 1] ~ dpois(lam[i, 1])
   
    for (t in 1:nyear) {
      lam[i, t] <- N[i, t] * exp(
        beta0 +
          beta_tree_height * w_tree_height[i, t] +
          beta_canopy_cover * w_canopy_cover[i, t] +
          beta_grassland * w_grassland[i, t] +
          beta_forest * w_forest[i, t]
      )
      N[i, t] ~ dpois(lam[i, t])
    }
  }
 
  # Observation process
  for (j in 1:nvisit) {
    mu_l_p[j] <- inprod(delta[1:ndelta], X_det[j, 1:ndelta])
    l_p[j] ~ dnorm(mu_l_p[j], sd = sd_p)
    logit(p[j]) <- l_p[j]
   
    # Using unique identifiers for the observations
    y_j <- count_array[year_id[j], , , site_id[j], visit_id[j]]
    y[j] ~ dbin(p[j], sum(y_j, na.rm = TRUE))  
   
    # Compute fit statistic
    eval[j] <- p[j] * sum(y_j, na.rm = TRUE)  
    y_new[j] ~ dbin(p[j], sum(y_j, na.rm = TRUE))  
    E[j] <- pow((y[j] - eval[j]), 2) / (eval[j] + 0.5)  
    E_new[j] <- pow((y_new[j] - eval[j]), 2) / (eval[j] + 0.5)  
  }
  fit <- sum(E[1:nvisit])
  fit_new <- sum(E_new[1:nvisit])
  bpvalue <- step(fit - fit_new)
 

})

# Parameters to Monitor
params <- c("alpha0", "sd_alpha", "beta0", "sd_p", "delta")

# Define initial values for the parameters
init <- list(
  beta = c(0, 0),  
  ss = 1,  
  alpha0 = 0,
  sd_alpha = 1,
  sd_p = 1,
  delta = rep(0, ndelta)  
)

# Prepare data for NIMBLE
nimble_data <- list(
  y = data$count,  # Your response variable
  year_id = as.integer(factor(data$year)), 
  site_id = as.integer(factor(data$site)),  
  visit_id = as.integer(factor(data$visit)),  
  count_array = count_array,
  X_det = X_det,
  nsite = nsite,
  nyear = nyear,
  nvisit = nvisit,
  ndelta = ndelta,
  nscale = nscale
)

# Compile the Model
compiled_model <- nimbleModel(nimblemodel, data = nimble_data, inits = init)
